movelist.name: Shadow Ball
movelist.effect: Shadow Ball lowers the foe’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Haze
movelist.effect: The Combat Stages of the user and all Pokémon and Trainers in the encounter are set to their default state (usually 0).

movelist.name: Stomp
movelist.effect: Stomp Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is at least one size category smaller than the user, Stomp deals an additional 10 damage.

movelist.name: Hex
movelist.effect: Once a Scene, if Hex’s target has a Status Affliction, you may have Hex’s Damage Base be 13 instead (4d10+10 / 35).

abilities.name: Grim Neigh
abilities.trigger: The user causes a foe to Faint with a
abilities.effect: The user’s Special Attack is raised by 1 Combat Stage. In addition, all foes within 3m of the user take a -2 penalty to Accuracy for one full round.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: All foes within 3 meters are Suppressed for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Fade Away
abilities.effect: The user becomes Invisible until the beginning of their next turn, and may immediately Shift. This Ability may be activated as an Interrupt when hit by a Physical attack; the user may declare the use of Fade Away to avoid all damage and/or effects of the move. Defensive.
